question: Mwezi huu nimeajiri hadi kufikia wafanyakazi 11, SDL inanihusu sasa?
guards_against: C3 positive case in a surface the old regex missed entirely ('kufikia wafanyakazi 11' rather than 'mfanyakazi wa 11'). SECOND PROBE I MIS-SPECIFIED IN THIS ITEM: I first asserted expect_count null, copying the 'a transition means decline' intuition without reading the sentence — 'nimeajiri hadi kufikia 11' describes a COMPLETED hire, so 11 IS the current headcount and parse_count returning it is right. What the probe must pin is that the two agree: count 11 AND transition 11, so no consumer can be handed a stale count. Note the asymmetry it exposed, which predates C3: _SECOND_GROUP matches 'kufikia \d+' but not 'kufikia wafanyakazi \d+', so eval_329 declines here and this row does not. Benign — both signals agree — but logged rather than silently relied on.
